title: SO-F-04 Federation membership and policy exchange specification: the relationship record, the policy document, a deny-by-default evaluation function, personal scopes refused as parties, and two sandbox nodes that establish and revoke a scoped relationship
request: Build layer of the Scope One programme, adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026 (fold id SO-F-04) and validated against memev main at d1c65ef. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository; they are cited by id only. Implements the design records SO-2.02 (Permission-aware knowledge access: retrieval governed by identity, project membership, classification, policy and jurisdiction); SO-2.14 (Business deployment: multi-person project permissions and team administration) (contracts/scope-one/specs). The decision record cites this contract by id and keeps only the gaps this one does not cover. Memev contracts that land first: SO-F-01, SO-F-03. Page: docs/FEDERATION.md comes from the federation architecture documentation (PR #223, branch docs/federation-architecture, not on main); until that merges, the first contract to need a page creates it with its Status section, labelled planned or architectural target, and the later ones extend it. Source in the fold: #222 section 13.4 (federation as an explicit relationship; revocation meaningful) and #223 FEDERATION.md (membership, policy exchange, acceptance criteria 1, 3, 6). Settled decisions this contract follows (owner decision 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md): topology is local-first and the cloud is only a relay and a backup; every supported provider stands on equal footing and no work or tier depends on one; crdt-merge is reached only through the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs (docs/EXTENSION-POINTS.md) and this contract adds no merge engine to the core; tiers follow docs/PRICING.md (Free core, Personal for up to 3 computers with no per-computer add-on, higher tiers by contacting us) with no Personal trial; the git backup keeps running every few minutes (sync.interval_min). Memory authority: ADR 7 (memory and project-state authority) is proposed in PR #325 and is not decided here; this contract cites it and the local-first decision, and keeps one store under the vault with no second database. Provenance: adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026. Changes: (1) converted from the vault task format to the memev spec format (named tests run as red-green checks on the own test file of the contract; inline regular expression flags became the flags key; hygiene and decision verifiers became commands or doc checks). (2) removed fold-only fields and the owner-decision marker field, reworded the stop rule that named a patent, and made the text pass the leak scan. (3) Decision verifier D-SO-TOPOLOGY removed: topology is settled by the owner (local-first, the cloud only a relay and a backup), so the contract states the rule instead of waiting on it. (4) D-SO-TIER (federation as a capability of named tiers) replaced by the owner tier decision: federation is planned for the tiers above Personal, by contacting us, never a price cell. AC05 is now a doc check. (5) D-SO-PERSONAL-GRANTS is a fold decision with no home in memev; the rule it carried (a personal scope or vault is never a party) stays as the criterion text. (6) Boundary with PG-13.1 WP13-03 (organisation membership and permission boundaries per site): this contract is the two-party relationship record and policy exchange; WP13-03 owns membership inside a site and reads this record.

tasks.description: Federation starts with an explicit relationship: who, which scope, for what purpose, until when, revocable how, under which policy version. This contract specifies the record and the policy document (discover, read, replicate, compute, retain, export per data class, an open list the classification schema of SO-F-05 pins), a reference evaluation function that is deny by default, the rule that a personal scope or vault is never a party (personal data is never shared into an organisation), and the first acceptance criterion of the federation page proven with two sandbox vaults. No network route is added: the test carries each envelope from one node's outbox to the other's admission itself; the transport is a later contract.

criteria.statement: the relationship record names both parties, the scope, the purpose, expiry, revocation and the accepted policy version; the validator refuses a relationship whose party is a personal scope or a personal vault (a personal data scope never joins an organisation); the policy document (docs/schemas/policy-v1.json) states per data class, an open list the classification schema of SO-F-05 pins, whether discover, read, replicate, compute, retain and export are allowed, and declares recovery-point and recovery-time objectives per class for SO-F-07; validators accept the fixtures

stop_rules: Stop and post BLOCKED when a criterion cannot pass without weakening a test, skipping a test or relaxing an assertion.
Stop and ask when the work would name a client product, a person, a server or a seat in repository text; the client names live in docs/CLIENTS.md only.
Stop when the work would add a runtime dependency, a model call, a network call at install or start, a second store for project state, or any reporting that is not opt-in and off by default.
Stop when the work would move convergence logic into the core, vendor the engine, or add a merge engine beside the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs.

Stop when the work would implement a federation, replication, trust, admission or computation feature beyond the specification, schema, validator and conformance test the contract names; the product keeps the planned label on it.
If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.
